active_family: 655 candidate: true sampled distribution score or deployability packaging around 652a/510a frontier
current_bottleneck: 654a shows that a pointwise terminal path loss is not enough. It slightly improves pathwise max-jump KS but weakens conditionality and daily-change fidelity. The bottleneck remains distributional allocation across plausible future paths, not decoder expressiveness, positive-support preprocessing, or a stronger pull toward the single realized future.
last_result_summary: 654a added an optional disabled-by-default terminal path objective to the shared-source multi-head path flow and trained joint38 with terminal_path_loss_weight=0.25, terminal_tail_weight=1.0. IV suite stayed 4/11. Pathwise max-jump KS improved from 652a 0.619 to 0.570 but still failed; conditionality worsened to 1.8% MAE reduction; daily-change KS fell to 12/25; level KS was 8/25; tail-scale was 12/25. Joint audit remained strong: factor KS mean 0.0989, factor KS pass 13/13, factor q99 pass 13/13, factor-factor corr 0.871, IV-factor corr 0.846.
next_step_recommendation: Do not promote 654a over 652a. If continuing local research, avoid another pointwise loss and test a true sampled distribution score (energy or sliced-Wasserstein over multiple generated futures) on the same backbone, or package 510a/392a as the IV-only deployable frontier and 652a as the clean native joint backbone.
current_best_note: 510a/392a remain the historical short-frame best learned IV laws at 8/11. On the 441-window broad frame, 612a is the highest IV-count native joint run at 6/11 but has a degenerate source-scale mechanism and poor anchor-factor joint audit. 574a remains the best risk-manager joint stress product but is a composed deck, not a calibrated joint law. 641a is the clean native joint baseline because it removes post-hoc gluing and recovers strong anchor-factor realism, but it is still only 4/11 on the IV suite.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
